chapters.title: Chapter 12: Kai’s Talent Limitation
paragraphs: As they waited for Kai to reveal more about his unique Talent, they suddenly heard a low rumble.
Wallace clutched his stomach, feeling a bit embarrassed.
A moment later, Claire’s belly growled too. Soon, Ralph and Victor followed, each of them realizing the same thing... they were starving.

None of them had chosen the Food Gift Pack or the Water Gift Pack. Now, the consequences of that decision distressed them. They glanced toward the area where food was distributed, but Russel had already explained it was only given at certain times.
Worse, the "meal" was nothing more than bitter nuts grown underground and some others that weren’t really that appetizing.
Their condition was terrible.
Kai noticed their pitiful gazes and gave a wry smile.

He then gestured for them to move closer. Then, he whispered so only they could hear. "Listen carefully. I can’t produce many Gift Packs, even with payment. It’s limited to three per day. Don’t reveal this to anyone else. If they learn about my Talent, they’ll take advantage of me. And if that happens, you won’t get anything from me. Remember... we’re all just Level 1. They can easily overpower us."
The four immediately nodded. There was no benefit in betraying Kai.
Even if they told Russel or the leaders, what would they gain? One of the three Gift Packs? Impossible. The three command leaders would seize everything for themselves.

But if they cooperated, if they kept Kai’s secret, then those three Gift Packs could be shared among them. Together, they could survive. In exchange, they would protect Kai when it came time to scavenge or fight outside.
Wallace clenched his fist. "We’ll guard your secret. No matter what."
Claire added softly, "Yes... We’ll keep this secret. I promise. If you need my super strength, I will work for you!"
Victor also agreed. "If we work together, we’ll get stronger... I will give you all free repairs with any of your equipment in the future with my Mechanic Talent."
Then, Ralph also promised that he’d be the best marksman with his talent and protect Kai.
Kai studied their faces, then finally nodded. "Good. In that case... I have a Food Gift Pack with me right now."
Their eyes lit up instantly. They didn’t know how they should pay him, but since Kai revealed it, he must have something in mind.
"I paid them with my Stat Points for now, so we can have it. I won’t explain further, but you don’t have to pay me for this time."
As he said this, he looked at everyone, and they all nodded at him.
Well, Kai decided to lie about the number of Gift Packs he could produce for a reason. He even decided to be vague about the payment process, so he could change it if needed.
Of course, another reason why he lied was that he still couldn’t protect himself, so he needed their assistance. Furthermore, it would also deter them from betraying him.
"Alright... Let’s do this."
Kai checked the inventory and recalled the contents of the Gift Pack.
[ Food Gift Pack (Basic) ]
[Contents: canned goods, instant noodles, granola bars, tea bags, and mayonnaise.]
He then silently produced one, careful not to draw attention. As he opened it, the items materialized in front of them.
Ten canned goods, ten packs of instant noodles, five granola bars, twenty tea bags, and one jar of mayonnaise!

The moment the cans and packets appeared, the four of them almost forgot where they were. Wallace’s eyes widened, Ralph’s jaw dropped, and Claire pressed her hand against her stomach as if the sight alone eased her hunger.
Victor also licked his lips upon seeing it.
It hadn’t been long since they entered this Apocalypse, but the sight of food had already made him like this.
They celebrated quietly, whispering their relief, but quickly forced themselves to shut their mouths.
The shelter was too crowded, too dangerous. If anyone else noticed, the Gift Pack would be gone in seconds.
Kai lowered his voice. "Perfect... We can divide them easily. Don’t waste anything. And remember... this stays between us."
Wallace nodded eagerly.

Soon, he was already clutching a can of meatloaf, a granola bar, an instant noodle pack, and four tea bags like they were treasure. "Don’t worry. We won’t let those bastard leaders take this from us."

Claire chuckled at Wallace’s words. Ralph smiled as he took his share. They didn’t have access to hot water right now, so the instant noodles and tea bags couldn’t be used yet. However, that was fine.
Of course, they didn’t touch the jar of mayonnaise and allowed Kai to keep it for himself.

Kai was satisfied with the contents of the pack and also with their reaction. This was actually the first time he had literally seen the contents. The system’s description had only listed the items, not the quantities.
Growl~
Claire’s stomach growled again, louder this time. She flushed, embarrassed, but quickly opened a granola bar from her share.
"Eat slowly. Don’t finish it all at once," Kai reminded her.
Just like that, the group settled into their miserable quarters. There was no water yet, but at the very least, Russel had said they could get drinkable water for free...
Then, after three hours, when everyone started feeling sleepy, Russel finally returned, carrying a platter filled with the scent of roasted nuts.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Dangerous Mission
paragraphs: Three hours passed. The group had already quenched their thirst at the deep‐well chamber, where survivors could scoop water freely.
The supply was abundant, though the taste carried an earthy aftertaste that clung to the tongue.
Still, it was drinkable, and no one had fallen ill from it. For now, it was enough.
Just as fatigue began to weigh on them, Russel returned.

He carried a wide platter, the scent of roasted nuts even drifted through the chamber. The smell was kind of bitter, smoky, and strangely comforting, though it reminded them of how little variety the shelter had to offer.
Apparently, the day shift’s work had ended. More people filtered into the chamber...

The sanitation crew arrived first, their hands still stained from cleaning waste channels. Behind them came the boiler operators, their clothes damp with sweat from the heat of the furnace rooms. Foragers and resource gatherers also moved in next, their faces tired from scavenging trips outside.
A few scouts leaned against the walls with their rifles slung casually over their shoulders, while other fighters entered last...
All of them turned their eyes toward the five new recruits.
"Fresh blood."
"Where did you all find them?"
"They look too clean... must’ve just arrived."
Claire shifted uncomfortably under the attention, while Wallace straightened his back, trying to look tougher than he felt.
Ralph adjusted his cracked glasses nervously, and Victor kept his gaze low, studying the chamber instead of meeting anyone’s eyes.
Russel set the platter down on a crude table made of scrap metal.
"Dinner," he said simply. The roasted nuts were portioned into small bowls, each barely enough to fill half a stomach.
He served the five recruits...
Of course, the others from the Food Handler Crew also brought more for others.
The workers lined up, taking their share without complaint. Yet their eyes kept flicking back to Kai’s group.
The newcomers were outsiders, untested, and everyone wanted to know what they would contribute.
One of the sanitation workers, a thin man with a scar across his chin, muttered loud enough for them to hear. "Hope they’re not freeloaders. Food’s tight as it is."
A boiler operator snorted. "Russel wouldn’t bring them here unless they had something. Still... five mouths to feed."
The tension was subtle but growing. The recruits could feel it pressing in, the weight of suspicion from dozens of tired, hungry survivors.
Well, they could understand their concern...
Kai glanced at his companions. They had already eaten the granola bar from the Gift Pack earlier, so they weren’t that hungry anymore. Still, the large peanuts weren’t as bad as they thought.
At this time, Russel noticed the stares and raised his voice. "They’ll be assigned work soon. Don’t worry... they’ll earn their share."
That calmed the crowd slightly, but the curiosity remained. The five recruits were marked now, watched closely by every division of Haven‐45.
Claire whispered. "Hmph... They’re all looking at us like we’re intruders."
Kai smiled, unbothered by their reaction. "Then we’ll prove we’re not."
Soon, the chamber had begun to quiet as most workers returned to their quarters.
The recruits thought the night might finally end in peace, until the sound of boots echoed once more.
Keagan, Julian, and Damon strode in. As expected, their presence immediately soured the atmosphere. The crowd parted instinctively, giving them space.
Keagan’s scarred face smirked. "So, the new recruits are settling in. Good. Tomorrow, you’ll be put to work."

Julian clasped his hand as if he was so excited to reveal their task. "Ahem... Your mission is not inside... Since you all have healthy bodies, you can work outside. Patrol duty. I’m sure it wouldn’t be dangerous."
Damon grinned... "Hey... It’s a little dangerous, no? But that’s necessary. If you survive, you’ll earn your place here."
Russel couldn’t help but fee shocked at their shamelessness. "They just arrived. Sending them outside already..."
Keagan silenced him with a glare. "They’ll do as they’re told."
Julian gestured toward a fighter lingering near the wall. The man stepped forward, rifle slung across his back. His eyes immediately locked on Claire, and they stayed there far too long.
"This one will accompany you," Julian said. "A guard. To make sure you return alive..."
As he said this, he turned to Claire with a smile.
Claire stiffened, her stomach twisting. The guard’s stare wasn’t protective... it was possessive. Everyone could feel it, though no one dared speak.
Wallace muttered under his breath, "Bastards..."
Victor clenched his fists, but Ralph tugged at his sleeve, silently warning him to stay quiet.
Russel and Augustine exchanged grim looks but said nothing. They knew better than to challenge the leaders openly. They still needed the gold liquid in order to get stronger.
Keagan chuckled after seeing their reactions. "Rest well, recruits. Tomorrow, you’ll prove your worth."
The three leaders left, with their laughter echoing down the corridor.
The guard remained for a moment with his gaze fixed on Claire before vanishing silently... Without a doubt, his level was far above theirs.
Kai couldn’t help but sigh at this...
He understood instantly... Their first task wasn’t just survival against machines. It was survival against the corruption inside Haven‐45.
"We have to learn how to level up..." Kai muttered.
Of course, they knew that it must be related to the A.I. Army.
They probably have to destroy them to get experience and level up, like some games, considering the format of their status panel.
However, they have the Beginner Protection!
"Should we leave the shelter and break away from the Beginner Protection zone?"

At this time, Russel noticed the stares and raised his voice.
"They’ll be assigned work soon.
Don’t worry... they’ll earn their share."
That calmed the crowd slightly, but the curiosity remained.
The five recruits were marked now, watched closely by every division of Haven‐45.
Claire whispered.
"Hmph...
They’re all looking at us like we’re intruders."
Kai smiled, unbothered by their reaction.
"Then we’ll prove we’re not."
Soon, the chamber had begun to quiet as most workers returned to their quarters.
The recruits thought the night might finally end in peace, until the sound of boots echoed once more.
Keagan, Julian, and Damon strode in.
As expected, their presence immediately soured the atmosphere.
The crowd parted instinctively, giving them space.
Keagan’s scarred face smirked.
"So, the new recruits are settling in.
Good.
Tomorrow, you’ll be put to work."
Julian clasped his hand as if he was so excited to reveal their task.
"Ahem...
Your mission is not inside...
Since you all have healthy bodies, you can work outside.
Patrol duty.
I’m sure it wouldn’t be dangerous."
Damon grinned...
"Hey...
It’s a little dangerous, no?
But that’s necessary.
If you survive, you’ll earn your place here."
Russel couldn’t help but fee shocked at their shamelessness.
"They just arrived.
Sending them outside already..."
Keagan silenced him with a glare.
"They’ll do as they’re told."
Julian gestured toward a fighter lingering near the wall.
The man stepped forward, rifle slung across his back.
His eyes immediately locked on Claire, and they stayed there far too long.
"This one will accompany you," Julian said.
"A guard.
To make sure you return alive..."
As he said this, he turned to Claire with a smile.
Claire stiffened, her stomach twisting.
The guard’s stare wasn’t protective... it was possessive.
Everyone could feel it, though no one dared speak.
Wallace muttered under his breath, "Bastards..."
Victor clenched his fists, but Ralph tugged at his sleeve, silently warning him to stay quiet.
Russel and Augustine exchanged grim looks but said nothing.
They knew better than to challenge the leaders openly.
They still needed the gold liquid in order to get stronger.
Keagan chuckled after seeing their reactions.
"Rest well, recruits.
Tomorrow, you’ll prove your worth."
The three leaders left, with their laughter echoing down the corridor.
The guard remained for a moment with his gaze fixed on Claire before vanishing silently...
Without a doubt, his level was far above theirs.
Kai couldn’t help but sigh at this...
He understood instantly...
Their first task wasn’t just survival against machines.
It was survival against the corruption inside Haven‐45.
"We have to learn how to level up..." Kai muttered.
Of course, they knew that it must be related to the A.I.
Army.
They probably have to destroy them to get experience and level up, like some games, considering the format of their status panel.
However, they have the Beginner Protection!
"Should we leave the shelter and break away from the Beginner Protection zone?"

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Done with Playing Passive
paragraphs: Kai’s group spent the rest of the night considering what they should do about the Beginner Protection Zone.
They knew that stepping beyond it would strip away their safeguard, leaving them exposed to the full brutality of the A.I. army.

Yet it also meant freedom, more areas to explore, more enemies to fight, and perhaps, a chance to finally level up. At Level 1, they were nothing. Without growth, they would remain prey inside this shelter, and they couldn’t just let it happen.
Still, they agreed to wait. First, they needed to see what kind of mission the leaders had forced on them, and how dangerous it truly was.
Kai and Ralph were the only ones who slept well.
Thanks to the Shelter Gift Pack, he had a tent and a sleeping bag, giving him a small pocket of comfort in the otherwise miserable quarters.
The others tossed and turned on the cold floor, as they weren’t used to this kind of condition yet.

Morning came with little ceremony. They managed to clean themselves with a basin of water, splashing away grime and sweat. It wasn’t much, but it helped them feel human again. Breakfast was the same as before, roasted nuts, but this time, it was paired with fried leaves. Bitter, dry, and barely filling.
Still, they ate without complaint since survival left no room for taste. They still have those canned meatloaf and instant noodles, but they haven’t opened them just yet.
Soon after, the guard appeared. The same man Julian had assigned with a rifle slung across his back, his eyes once again lingered on Claire like last night.
He said nothing, but his presence was heavy, suffocating. Kai’s group exchanged uneasy glances, but none dared speak.
"Time to move," the guard finally said. He said with his gaze never leaving Claire.
They followed him through the familiar tunnel... The light was barely giving them vision but it was enough to walk through the tunnel.
Soon, they reached the hatch. With a groan of rusted metal, it opened, and the stench of the garbage dump rushed in.
The man actually selected the entrance closest to the organic waste area.
The recruits gagged, covering their noses.
They could barely breathe with the air filled with rot, sour and acrid, clinging to their throats.
Mountains of waste stretched before them, piled high like hills.
There was broken machinery and twisted scrap around them, but they were close to the rotting organic matter mixed in a landscape of trash...
The guard gestured toward the horizon. "Alright... I’ll only say this once... This is the dump. Six sectors in total. Sectors One to Three are for organic waste."
As he said this, he pointed at those three sectors...
"The machine army’s transporters drop food scraps, meat, and other perishables there. Sectors Four to Six are mixed... metal, plastic, and whatever else the army discards."
The recruits froze, staring at him in disbelief.
"Organic waste?" Ralph muttered. "Food? Meat? So those things didn’t come from human waste, but the A.I. Army?"
Victor frowned. "Why would the A.I. army have food? They don’t eat... do they?"
Claire shook her head. "No way. Machines don’t need food."
Wallace couldn’t understand either... "Then why throw it away here? What are they doing with it?"
"Haha!"
The guard suddenly laughed. It sounded harsh as it echoed across the dump. It wasn’t the laugh of amusement, it was the laugh of someone who knew far more than he was willing to share.
"You don’t understand the A.I. army at all," he said.
"You think they’re just machines that kill on sight? No... sometimes, they capture humans."
The five froze as they realized this...
Those organic waste... perhaps, they were leftovers of those captured humans?
Claire’s breath caught in her throat.
Ralph’s hands trembled as he imagined himself getting captured. That was definitely not a good idea.
Even Kai felt a chill crawl down his spine.
’Captured?’The thought alone was worse than death.
The guard smirked at their reaction, clearly enjoying their unease.

"You’ll learn soon enough. For now, keep your eyes open. Patrol the dump. No weapons for you, orders from above. But don’t worry, there are hidden entrances all around this place. If things go bad, dive down into the tunnels. If you’re fast enough, you might live."
He gestured toward the jagged hills of scrap and twisted wires. "Memorize them. They’re your only lifeline."
The recruits exchanged uneasy glances. Patrolling the garbage dump without weapons felt like a death sentence, but they had no choice.
Of course, those with guns hid it well, since they knew that they couldn’t trust these scavengers.
The guard checked the time, then motioned for them to follow. "Move."
They crouched low and moved through piles of broken metal and rotting waste until they reached a cover of tangled wires and scraps.
The stench was suffocating, but they held their breath and waited.
Suddenly, the faint hum of rotors filled the air.
A small drone that was foot-sized glided past overhead.
It was a Swarmer.
No explanation was needed. Everyone knew what it was.
"They pass through this area at specific times," the guard whispered.

"Soon, the transport group of the A.I. army will drop their waste materials. We’ll wait for it. But don’t approach the trash they throw away, that’s for the gatherers later. Instead, we’ll follow the transport group as much as we can."
Wallace’s eyes widened. "What? Follow them? That’s suicidal!"
Victor hissed under his breath. "We don’t even have weapons..."
Claire frowned. Her instincts were screaming that this was madness.
"If we’re caught..."
Kai finally understood that those three leaders probably wanted to properly control them to become more submissive, or perhaps, they just wanted them dead!
’Fine... I’ll show you what we can do.’
Kai was finally done observing... He felt that he had already seen enough.
He already learned about the A.I. Army, the Transporters, the other humans who were being captured, the Underground Shelter’s inner workings, and other details...
It was time to make his move!

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Revealing Shelter’s Weakness
paragraphs: Kai subtly signaled to Claire and Wallace, who had both selected Weapon Gift Pack like him.
He placed his hand inside his dark jacket, the Tier 1 Survivor Jacket they all have.
Both of them understood immediately. Like him, they had revolvers hidden beneath their dark coats, concealed from the guard’s eyes.
Moments later, the ground trembled with a low mechanical sound...
From afar, a massive Transporter rolled into view.
It was a towering machine, shaped like a cargo hauler, its body plated with black steel and streaked with glowing red lines.
Six enormous wheels churned through the garbage, and due to their weight, they could hear it crushing metal and bone alike. The stench grew worse as its cargo bay opened, revealing heaps of waste.
Before unloading, a Sentinel dropped down from the Transporter’s side.
The humanoid machine was indeed quite tall, as they were told.
Its armored body seemed durable as well, and they knew that their revolvers would probably not work against that thing unless they targeted its soft parts.
Furthermore, they saw its rifle slung across its chest. It was definitely a high-tech weapon!
’Advanced Tech weapon, huh... This is too unfair.’ Kai frowned as he observed the Sentinel.
He watched as its glowing eyes scanned the dump silently...
Each step it took sent vibrations through the trash, as if warning any intruders to stay hidden.
Kai’s group, including the guard, held their breath as the Sentinel prowled the area.
Finally, satisfied, it signaled back to the Transporter. With a mechanical groan, the cargo bay tilted, and tons of garbage spilled out.
Rotten food, twisted scraps of flesh, a very few broken machinery, and unidentifiable sludge cascaded down the mound, cluttering the dump even further.
Soon, the guard spoke.
"Move," he ordered.
The four looked at Kai. He gave a calm gesture, urging them to follow. He didn’t plan to let this man do as he wished... he was merely waiting for an opportunity.
After all, with his Talent, he could eventually control the whole shelter. He only needed the strength to protect himself.
If he wanted to survive the Mech Siege, he had to get stronger as fast as possible! Eliminating this guard was just one of many obstacles.
Just like that, they crept closer to the edge of the dump, and then it happened.
A glowing message appeared before their eyes, visible only to them.
[ Warning: Moving further will remove your Beginner Protection. ]
They were all familiar with this, since the system had already warned them before.
However, the guard didn’t react since he couldn’t see it. This was a system message meant only for survivors like them.
They had already discussed this last night, so they all looked determined.
They exchanged silent nods, and together, they stepped forward.
Another notification appeared instantly...
[ Beginner Protection has been removed. ]
’We’ve done it...’
’We trust you, Kai.’
’There’s no going back...’
’This is crazy... I hope this works.’
Wallace, Claire, Ralph, and Victor couldn’t help but feel a little nervous.
The air had even changed as it felt heavier, as if the world itself had changed.
Apparently, they were vulnerable now.
The guard smirked, oblivious to their system messages.
"Follow the Transporter. Stay close. I’ll cover the rear."
But Kai noticed something. The guard wasn’t watching the Transporter at all. His eyes kept turning toward a nearby mound of scrap. Without a doubt, it was where a hidden tunnel entrance lay.
He was keeping track of it, inching closer with every step.
’I see...’
Then came the order that revealed his true colors.
"Step out of cover. Keep pace with the Transporter. Don’t fall behind."
Wallace’s eyes widened. "That’ll get us spotted!"
Victor looked at the man to see if he was joking... "Is he insane?"
Kai wryly smiled. The guard was seriously underestimating them.
Indeed, the guard wasn’t insane, it was his plan all along. He wanted them noticed by the enemy.
The Sentinel would engage, the Transporter would react, and in the chaos, the guard would grab Claire and slip into the tunnel. The rest of them would die as bait.
Fine... we deal with him now. Even with the level difference, we can do this.
He glanced at Claire and Wallace, whose hands silently touched their hidden revolvers.
They knew they had to move now, while the noise of the trash spilling across the dump still masked their actions.
Kai gave the signal.
Wallace moved first, stepping silently across the cluttered trash. Claire mirrored him, her revolver hidden but ready.
Victor and Ralph moved to flank, while Kai himself angled toward the guard’s blind side.
The man was too focused on the Transporter and the tunnel entrance to notice.
In one swift motion, Wallace kicked at the guard’s foot, knocking him off balance.
Thud!
At the same time, Kai drove his shoulder into the man’s torso, forcing him backward.
Claire pressed in from the other side, ensuring he couldn’t recover!
Before the guard could cry out, Wallace wrapped his arm around the man’s neck, locking him in a chokehold.
Of course, the guard’s level must be higher than theirs, so he wouldn’t easily go down!
Unfortunately for him, he was caught in an awkward position before he mustered his strength!
With Wallace’s Iron Stamina Talent, he could keep his position for a long time!
As expected, the guard didn’t immediately lose consciousness!
As a matter of fact, it took them the whole five minutes holding him in such a position before the guard showed signs of weakening.
The guard thrashed, clawing at Wallace’s arm, but the others pressed their weight down, pinning his body against the mound of scrap.
"Hold him," Kai whispered sharply.
The struggle soon ended after ten minutes!
This shocked everyone!
The guard’s movements grew weaker, and soon, his eyes rolled back as consciousness slipped away. Finally, his body went limp in Wallace’s grip.
That was more than ten minutes of choking him! Even Wallace felt his arms go numb...
"That’s crazy..." Wallace muttered as he lowered the man’s head carefully to the ground, making sure no noise carried across the dump.
The Sentinel was still prowling in the distance, and any sound could mean death.
Victor quickly snatched the rifle from the guard’s hands. He checked the chamber, then froze.
"...It’s empty," he muttered.
Ralph’s eyes widened. "No bullets?"
They all looked disappointed, but Kai saw this as an opportunity!

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Unusual Behavior
paragraphs: Kai’s gaze lingered on his teammates.

He had already understood the opportunity the moment Victor revealed the rifle was empty. If the guards of Haven‐45 were bluffing with weapons that couldn’t fire, then the balance of power had already shifted.
With three real revolvers hidden among them, his group had the means to challenge the shelter’s false authority.
Well, he could even increase the number of their revolvers with his Weapon Gift Pack!
But he didn’t mention it yet. The Transporter was still rumbling nearby, and the Sentinel’s glowing eyes started looking around the dump.
Now that their Beginner Protection was gone, one mistake could mean death. For now, silence was needed...
However, this silence was broken by the faint metallic thuds of the Sentinel moving across the garbage hills.
Thud... Thud...
Its heavy steps could be heard as it scanned for disturbances. For a moment, Kai thought it had noticed them.
The Sentinel actually paused with its sensors sweeping the area. But then it turned away, following another sound deeper in the dump.
The group exhaled quietly, relief washing over them.
Then, suddenly, the system chimed in their vision.
[ Congratulations! First Kill Achieved. ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +30 Experience Points ]
[ Reminder: EXP distribution is based on participation. Minimal contribution yields reduced gains. ]
The five froze.
Claire’s eyes widened as he read the message.
"He... died?" She said this as softly as possible while looking at the man sprawled on the trash.
Wallace wryly smiled as they certainly aimed to eliminate the guy. Still, confirming the kill made him feel a little numb...
The guard hadn’t just lost consciousness, he was truly gone.
Victor clenched his fists. "It’s necessary..."
This was everyone’s first kill, and it was even a human, not an A.I. Machine in this Apocalypse.
Kai could understand everyone’s reaction to this matter, but their current situation didn’t allow them to be sentimental about this. They would be the ones getting killed if they acted weakly.
Nonetheless, the system wasn’t finished yet.
[ Reminder: Killing fellow humans yields extremely low experience points. Survivors are advised to focus on the true enemy. ]
’Ohhh...’ Kai and the others gently nodded after getting the same notification.
Of course, none of them had leveled up, but it didn’t matter.
They learned how to get experience points and confirmed that fighting each other was not a good option. After all, experience points distribution was nerfed if they turn against humans.
The system had made its stance clear... Human lives weren’t meant to be the path to strength. The real war was against the machines.
The group exchanged glances, confirming that they all understood the message.
Unfortunately, as they planned to loot the guard and see his items, the Sentinel started moving...
’No... Let’s move!’ Kai signaled with his hands as he pointed at the area filled with barbed wires and scrap metal where they could hide.
The five quickly moved away, crouching low as Kai led them toward the cover.
They also slowed their breaths as they nervously looked at the Sentinel’s movement.
Thud... Thud...
Soon, the machine stopped.
Its eyes locked onto the corpse of the fallen guard.
For a moment, Kai thought it would simply ignore the body. But instead, the Sentinel bent down, scanning the corpse thoroughly as if it were searching for something.
The group was confused as they watched from their hiding spot.
After several seconds, the Sentinel’s sensors pulsed red.
Without hesitation, it raised its weapon, but not to fire, but to act as a blade. In one swift motion, it beheaded the guard.
Ssaakk!
Claire covered her mouth as she saw this.
The others then realized that it was trying to make sure that the guard was indeed dead.
For a moment, they considered attacking. However, Kai shook his head.
"Not yet," he whispered.
The Sentinel’s weapon was not simple. One wrong move and they would all be cut down.
Then came the most shocking part. The Sentinel seemed to be planning to explore the garbage dump even further, but an alarm from the Transported halted its movement.
Then, it picked up the severed head, holding it like evidence, and marched back to the Transporter.
It was as if its time had run out!
Just like that, the massive machine accepted the head into its cargo bay. And soon, the Transporter rumbled away, leaving the dump once again.
Everyone was stunned.
"What... was that?" Ralph whispered, his voice trembling.
"They took the head..." Claire muttered, her eyes wide. "Why?"
Victor clenched his fists. "Do they... collect human heads or something?"
"That’s scary... Maybe they planned to study its brain? Look into its memories or something? Haha... That would be terrible..." Wallace laughed as he said this.
However, the group exchanged uneasy glances...
Realizing how messed up it was, Wallace shook his head.
"No way, right?" Wallace said.
"I don’t think the A.I. machines would have such technology. Yeah... don’t suggest something that terrifying," Victor said, shaking his head.
Kai, on the other hand, also hoped the head wouldn’t be used for that purpose. Still, it proved how little they truly knew about the A.I. Army.
"Sshh~ They might still be here..." Claire reminded them to lower their voice.
Then, after several tense minutes of watching and listening, they finally confirmed there were no enemies nearby.
Only then did the group ease their shoulders, letting out the breath they had been holding.
"Alright, listen..." Kai said suddenly, drawing their attention.
"That guard’s rifle was empty, right? No bullets. If he was bluffing, then maybe all the guards in Haven‐45 are the same. Maybe their authority is built on fear, not strength. What do you think?"

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Gene Enhancement
paragraphs: At this time, Kai repeated his words. "Hands up!"
Keagan’s face twisted with rage.
He refused to raise his hands. Instead, he gripped his metal bat tightly and charged forward.
Normally, he would only use this bat to punish the workers he didn’t like. He wouldn’t bring other weapons, like a knife or blade, but now he had no choice but to rely on it.
"Do you think I’ll bow to you?" he shouted, swinging the bat at Kai.
But Kai didn’t move. He already knew he didn’t need to fire.
Bang!
The shot came from Ralph, echoing through the room.
The sound was dizzying in the confined space, but they endured it.
Keagan staggered back, clutching his side in pain. Then, he realized what had happened!
"No... Mom!"
His eyes widened in disbelief as blood seeped through his clothes.
Perhaps, due to shock, he collapsed against the table as the bat slipped from his grip.
They didn’t know if he had died or simply lost consciousness.
Claire and Victor froze, their hands trembling. Neither of them had the heart to pull the trigger. But Ralph’s sharp aim had saved Kai from the strike.
Julian’s smirk vanished. His face had already turned pale as he realized the truth. Damon was dead, and Keagan was down. He was the last one left!
"I... I can give you supplies," Julian stammered, raising his hands.
"The gold liquid... the rest of it. I’ll show you where it is."
He didn’t ask why they were doing this. Deep down, he knew. They had started this mess. They had sent William to kill the recruits and take Claire.
Julian slowly reached into his pocket and pulled out a small iron key. He held it up with shaking fingers.
"This opens the safe. The remaining gold liquid is inside."
But Kai wasn’t looking at him. Instead, his eyes were fixed on the door behind.
The sound of gunfire had already spread panic through the shelter. It was not surprising that they started gathering here to check the situation.
Soon, shouts and hurried footsteps echoed outside the chamber.
The residents of the shelter were worried, unsure of what was happening.
Only Russel wasn’t surprised. After all, he was the one who had pointed out the location of the three leaders. He was just there watching silently as Kai and the group finished the job.
Suddenly, two of Julian’s loyal guards rushed in with weapons raised.
Seeing them, Julian shouted desperately, "Kill them! I’ll give you all the gold liquid if you save me!"
Kai’s eyes turned cold as he heard these words."Bad move."
Still, the two guards charged recklessly, but they didn’t stand a chance.
Ralph fired again with the revolvers in both hands.
Bang! Bang!
The two were shot, but unlike the leaders, they weren’t weak-hearted. Even after being hit, they still tried to fight. They also consumed five drops of gold liquid at the very least!
Wallace, already dizzy from the echo of gunfire, chose not to shoot again. Instead, he swung his hatchet, cutting down the second guard before he could reach them.
This time, even Claire and Victor acted. They threw their hatchets, ending the fight.
Thud! Thud!
Both guards fell to the ground, lifeless.
Julian’s knees buckled. He stared at the bodies of his men with his lips already trembling. "No... no..."
Kai stepped forward with the revolver pointed at him.
Bang!
There was no need for words. He could never let such an evil person live if he wanted to take over the shelter. Otherwise, he risked being backstabbed.
Thud...
Julian’s body jerked as the bullet struck him.
A system notification appeared before Kai’s eyes but he ignored it for now. Soon, Julian collapsed beside Keagan, still clutching the iron key.
Just like that, the chamber fell silent except for the heavy breathing of Kai’s group.
Three leaders of Haven‐45 were gone.
The noise of gunfire had already spread fear. Survivors gathered in the corridor, whispering nervously.
None of them celebrated the fall of the three leaders. Instead, their eyes were filled with worry.
They had lived under Keagan, Julian, and Damon for years. Even if those men were cruel, they had been in charge, and the shelter had survived... barely.
Now, with guns in the hands of newcomers, the survivors feared things might become even worse.
Some stepped back, unsure of what these new survivors were planning.
Of course, Kai understood their worry.
The sight of revolvers made them uneasy. Many had probably never seen anyone fire real bullets before.
He holstered his weapon and raised his voice so everyone could hear.
"We’re not here to hurt you. We’re here to survive together."
Then, he opened his inventory and produced several glowing notifications. He knew how to resolve this matter.
[ Food Gift Pack (Basic) ] ×5
[ Water Gift Pack (Basic) ] ×5
Since they were worried, he decided to feed them and ease the tension!
Kai handed out canned goods, granola bars, and bottles of clean water. Wallace and the others assisted, and hunger and thirst quickly overcame fear.
Slowly, the survivors reached out and accepted the supplies.
The taste of granola bars and the cool water brought relief.
’Good... with my SSS Talent, this is possible,’ Kai thought.
He was willing to supply them with food and drinks or other gift packs, since this would earn their trust.
However, he kept the Weapon Gift Packs separate. Only Wallace, Ralph, Claire, and Victor could receive revolvers and hatchets for now.
He knew better than to arm everyone at once. Trust had to be earned.
After the situation calmed down, Kai finally turned to the iron key Julian had been holding.
’Gold liquid, huh...’Kai mused, curious about this mysterious gene‐enhancement liquid.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: The Gold Liquid
paragraphs: After handing out food and water, Kai and the rest checked the notifications they had received after killing the three leaders.
Obviously, the messages weren’t the same for everyone, since their participation had been different this time.

Damon was killed by Wallace alone, a clean shot straight to the heart. Keagan had fallen to Ralph, who fired at him before the bat could land. As for the two guards, Ralph, Claire, and Victor had cooperated to bring them down.
Finally, Kai himself had killed Julian.
Each of them had played their part.
As for Kai, he had a new achievement.
[ First Solo Kill Achieved. ]
[ +60 Experience Points ]
[ Bonus: Stat Increase - Spirit +1 ]
This time, there was no reminder about how killing humans yielded low experience points or that they should focus on the true enemy. Instead, the system highlighted the bonus stat.
"I got an increase in Spirit," Kai muttered, glancing at the notification.
"Ohh. Me too!" Wallace said quickly after checking his own.
"Yep, I got it too... Maybe Claire and Victor will get theirs once they make their first solo kill," Ralph added, realizing how the system worked.
They could have kept talking about experience points and rewards, but their attention shifted to the small iron key. Julian had died clutching it, and now it was in Kai’s hand.
They wanted to know more about this so-called gold liquid.
But, before they could discuss further, Augustine and Russel approached. The two men, who had first found and brought these five survivors into Haven‐45, couldn’t hold back their emotions.
They were relieved.
The three leaders were finally gone. More than that, they were moved by the fact that Kai’s group had chosen to share food and water with everyone instead of ruling them through fear with their guns.
That single act of generosity had already won their hearts.
"You... you saved us," Russel muttered with his voice trembling. "I thought Haven‐45 was finished. But now... now we have a chance."
Augustine nodded firmly beside him.

They knew better than anyone how dire the situation of the shelter truly was. The food supply was dwindling, the pillars holding the underground chamber were crumbling, the bitter cold of winter was approaching, and the A.I. army above was growing more active with each passing week.
All of these problems had to be addressed. But the three leaders had never been capable of solving them.
Now, with Kai’s group here, Augustine and Russel felt, that survival might actually be possible.
"You can trust us... We will make this shelter more livable." Kai promised.
Then, after a few more minutes, when the tension eased, he finally asked the question that had been bothering him.
"What do we do with these corpses? Five of them... the three leaders and their two guards."
Russel answered without hesitation. "We’ll use them as fuel in the boiler room."
The five didn’t expect that at all. However, it somehow made sense since there was probably no graveyard here.
Then, seeing that they have several questions in their mind, Russel quickly called for Gabby, one of the operators in charge of the Boiler Room, to give more details.
Gabby arrived, a thin man with soot-stained clothes, though his hands were surprisingly clean. Everyone could see that he had just gobbled up a granola bar.
Nonetheless, he bowed slightly before speaking.

"The boiler room has an advanced tech obtained from the A.I. Base, the elder said to me before. It doesn’t produce smoke, so the shelter isn’t discovered from above. That’s why we can keep burning waste without alerting the Sentinels."
Kai and the others listened carefully. They weren’t familiar with how the boiler worked or what it could do. Still, it seemed that they had to visit it later.

Gabby continued, "We incinerate everything here, trash, scraps, even human waste. It keeps the shelter clean and provides steady heat. We could also boil water with it, but we don’t bother. The well water is drinkable enough. Even if it has bacteria, everyone here has consumed at least three drops of gold liquid. That’s why our bodies can endure it."
Kai nodded slowly. It was practical, though grim. Using the corpses as fuel meant nothing went to waste.
Then, Gabby continued to explain that the boiler was also being used to produce electricity.
The heat converted into steam drives turbines, and it was not much, but enough for lights, ventilation, and some machines.
After being satisfied with this explanation, their attention shifted back to the iron key Julian had died clutching.
Russel pointed toward the far side of the chamber.
"There. That vault contains the gold liquid."
The group moved closer.
The vault was built into the wall with its surface scratched and dented from years of use.
Soon, Kai inserted the key, and with a heavy click, the lock disengaged.
Clank!
The door creaked open, revealing ten small vials inside... However, there were only three of them with remaining gold liquid. Even the third one only had half of it left.
Well, it was already surprising that the three previous leaders didn’t consume it all despite looking so greedy.
’Maybe there’s a penalty or something?’Kai mused.
Then, at that moment, the system reacted.
[ Congratulations! You have discovered Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum! ]
[ +10 Experience Points ]
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum: Rare genetic resource developed by the fallen World Government. ]
[ Effect: Permanently increases base stats upon consumption. Small chance of awakening a Gene Skill. ]
[ Warning: Excessive use may cause instability. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Leveling Up
paragraphs: The agreement they had made earlier was clear. The two full vials were entrusted to Kai, while the four would share the half‐filled vial among themselves.
Russel had already explained that each vial contained about two hundred or more drops, judging from the viscosity and the dropper they had found.
It was a staggering amount.

But Russel also warned them. "Don’t be greedy. Most of us can only handle five to eight drops before our bodies reject them. Of course, it might be different for you guys since I think you’re all special."
He paused after saying this.
"Anyway, after we felt the rejection, we needed at least a year or two before consuming again. The leaders hoarded it, which is why no one else ever had the chance."
The five then nodded. They understood the risks now.
On the other hand, Russel was worried that he had been misunderstood, so he quickly explained himself.
"For your group... We don’t really mind even if we don’t get any more gold liquid."
Since Kai had promised them food, weapons, protection, and better shelter in the near future, they felt more inclined to give it up...
Kai had already shown how generous he was and given them food that they had never tasted before.
They didn’t mind if he got all the gold liquid as long as he kept his promise.
"Alright... Let’s try it out!" Victor said with a hint of excitement.
Soon, the dropper was prepared and opened one of the full vials.
There was no scent whatsoever. However, none of them doubted its effects because the system confirmed what they are.
Plop...
The golden liquid glowed faintly as Kai raised it. The others watched in silence as they waited for Kai to try it...
Soon, he tilted his head back and let a single drop fall onto his tongue.
The taste was quite metallic, almost burning as it slid down his throat. His body tensed immediately, heat spreading through his chest.
Russel mentioned this since it would happen for first-timers, so Kai didn’t panic.
Then, the system reacted.
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum Consumed - 1 Drop ]
[ +100 Experience Points ]
[ Permanent Stat Increase: Health +5, Spirit +1 ]
Kai was already happy with this benefit, but it didn’t end there.
[ Congratulations! First Gene Serum Consumed! ]
[ First-Time Bonus: +1 Gene Skill Point ]
[ Note: Gene Skill Point can be used to level up a Gene Skill. ]
Kai’s eyes widened slightly as the notifications flashed before him.
"I received experience points, an increase in my Health and Spirit Points... I also got a first-time bonus." Kai shared.
The heat in his body had also settled into a steady rhythm.
But just like what Russel said, since it was their first time, they could immediately feel that something had changed in their bodies.
"Kai... What about Gene Skill? Did you get one?" Claire asked.
Kai shook his head. "Nah... But it works. My body feels... stronger... Just try it yourselves.
Just like that, everyone got their first drop of Gene Serum. They received similar bonuses, and as expected, no one received Gene Skill yet.
Of course, they weren’t planning to stop there.
Kai continued, curious to see if he could level up.

Based on his count, he already had 200 Experience Points. He had earned 30 points for the first kill, 60 points for the solo kill, 10 points for discovering the serum, and now 100 points for consuming it.
However, the second drop was different.
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum Consumed - 1 Drop ]
[ +50 Experience Points ]
[ Permanent Stat Increase: Health +5, Spirit +1 ]
Instead of getting 100, he received just half... Kai was immediately worried!
After all, the third drop might only give him 25 points!
Without waiting for others to ask a question, Kai tried a third drop.
In any case, he wasn’t feeling any signs of rejection. Furthermore, he no longer felt the heat and changes in his body after the second one. It seemed that his body had now adjusted.
"Whew... That’s better." Kai muttered after seeing the third notification.
[ +50 Experience Points ]
[ Permanent Stat Increase: Health +5, Spirit +1 ]
It was still 50 points!
’I guess the first one is really special.’ Kai mused as he heaved a sigh of relief.
Just like that, the group continued consuming the Gene Serum since they felt that they could do so.
Kai even wanted to just gulp one vial, but he stopped himself...
Still, he finally realized the amount of experience needed to level up!
It was 500 Experience Points!
[ You have leveled up! ]
As expected, since this was his first level up, more system notifications appeared, almost dizzying him.
Still, they were all pieces of information he badly needed.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: New Stat and the Elder
paragraphs: [ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 2 ]
[ Health Points +10 ]
[ Spirit Points +2 ]
[ Physique Rating has slightly improved! ]
[ Inventory Slots Expanded: +1 ]
From this part, Kai had to pause as he didn’t understand the physique rating. It hadn’t been mentioned before.
As for the Inventory Slot, it seemed that it was related to the fact that he could finally store something within his inventory!
Although it was just one slot, it was already amazing. After all, he knew that this would improve even more as he continued levelling up.
[ New Feature Unlocked: Physique Rating ]
[ Current Physique: E ]
[ Description: Physique Rating measures overall body condition, including strength, endurance, agility, and resilience. ]
[ Note: Rating improves through various methods, including training, medicine consumption, leveling, and others. ]

Kai finally realized why his Status only had Health and Spirit Points and no Strength, Agility, or other stats like in many games he had seen before. It was actually all connected to the Physique Rating!
After that, Kai continued checking the notifications. Thankfully, this time, he finally knew the amount of Experience Points he needed!
[ Progression Requirement Updated ]
[ Next Level: 600 Experience Points ]
"It only increased by a hundred... Not bad." Kai muttered. He then realized that he could just continue consuming the Gene Serum.
But before that, he confirmed that the others could all level up as well.
"My Physique is rated E..." Wallace muttered as he saw the message.
"Same..."
"Me too..."
Ralph and Victor said, and soon, they looked at Claire, who was silent.
"W-well... Are you sure there’s no ’plus’ included? Mine’s showing E+..." Claire explained.
Kai and the others then quickly checked their status to confirm what they had. However, it was indeed just the Letter E.
[ Survivor Status ]
[ Name: Kai
Title: Beginner Survivor
Level: 2
Health: 145/145
Spirit: 60/60
Physique Rating: E
Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS)
Active Skills: None
Passive Skills: None
Skill Point: 1 ]
His status had certainly improved a lot. After all, he got 5 Health points and 1 Spirit points for each drop of the Gene Serum. Including the bonus he got, he now had a decent stat.
"It might be related to my talent..." Claire revealed.
Immediately, the others understood. Her Talent was related to Physical Strength, and it was certainly understandable for her to get a better rating.
"Alright! Let’s finish this up!" Victor said as he saw that there was still some Gene Serum in the half-filled vial.
After all, there could be 100 drops here, and they barely used half of it.
As for Kai, he probably had to drink the vial directly since he would get tired consuming it drop by drop.
"I’m also thinking of doing that... But I will first attempt to reach Level 5 with this method. If I don’t sense any rejection, then I’ll do that." Kai explained.
In the meantime, while Kai and the others were busy with the Gene Serum, another resident of Haven‐45, Dustin, quietly descended into the lowest chamber of the shelter.
He was a man in his thirties and was part of the Sanitation Crew.
Soon, his steps slowed as he approached the Elder’s quarters. Few dared to come here, but there was no hesitation in his movement.
The chamber was dim, lit only by a faint glow from the old medical equipment.
Inside, there was a scent of blood and herbs within this room.
"Elder..." Dustin muttered as he looked at the figure inside the chamber.

On the bed sat the Elder, a frail figure covered in tubes and dextrose lines. His body was so weak that he could no longer move on his own. Right now, he was propped up only by cushions and the frame of the bed.
Dustin hesitated at the doorway.

Despite everything, the corruption of the leaders, the suffering they had caused, he still felt loyalty to this man. The Elder had once been the heart of Haven‐45, even if age and frailty had stolen his strength.
The Elder’s eyes opened as he heard someone entering... Soon, his gaze settled on Dustin, and though his lips barely moved, a faint whisper escaped. "Report..."
Dustin stepped closer while lowering his head.
"Elder... Damon, Julian, and Keagan... they’re gone. The shelter has new leadership now."
For a moment, silence filled the chamber.
The Elder’s chest rose and fell slowly... Then, his eyes glistened as tears welled up and slid down his cheeks.
Dustin clenched his fist, but didn’t say anything more.
Just like that, the Elder’s lips trembled, but no words came.
Though Damon, Julian, and Keagan had been cruel leaders, selfish and corrupt, they were still his flesh and blood.
Then, his gaze drifted toward the ceiling, as if searching for memories of the sons he had once held with pride. Flawed as they were, they had carried his lineage, his hopes, and now they were gone.
A few minutes passed, and soon, the Elder had calmed his emotions...
This time, he had a determined look on his face.
"I... I want to meet... them." The Elder weakly said while looking at Dustin.
For a moment, Dustin hesitated. After all, it wouldn’t be surprising if Kai decided to end the Elder’s sufferings.
Still, he knew there was no room for refusal, so he slightly bowed his head and replied.
"I understand... Elder."

chapters.title: Chapter 25: The Milestone
paragraphs: "Yay! Level three! I got it!" Claire exclaimed as she confirmed the notification.
At this time, everyone in the Leader’s Chamber was focused on their Gene Serum consumption.
Since Claire, Wallace, Victor, and Ralph were sharing the half-filled vial with about 100 drops, they would only get around 25 drops each.
About seven or eight drops were needed to reach Level 2, while twelve drops were required to reach Level 3, since it had the requirement of 600 Experience Points.
Because of that, it was impossible to continue further. Still, they consumed as much as they could to gain more Health and Spirit Points.
Unfortunately, reaching Level 3 no longer granted an additional reward. But all of them had reached Level 3, and even if it didn’t improve their Physique Rating, they were satisfied with the result.
"Go on, Kai... just drink the whole thing. I’m sure you’ll be fine. We have a different physique compared to the natives... or residents here," Wallace suggested.
"I think I can try that," Kai muttered as he checked his current status after leveling up once again.
[ Survivor Status ]
[ Name: Kai ]
[ Title: Beginner Survivor ]
[ Level: 4 ]
[ Spirit: 88/88 ]
[ Physique Rating: E ]
[ Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
[ Active Skills: None ]
[ Passive Skills: None ]
[ Skill Point: 1 ]

"But... let me try to reach Level 5 first. I just realized... this requirement is huge," Kai said as he rechecked the notification, realizing that he might actually receive another special announcement from the system after reaching the Level 5 milestone.

This wasn’t a random guess. After all, he had noticed a pattern. Since reaching Level 3 required 600 Experience Points, and reaching Level 4 required 700 Experience Points, he expected 800 Experience Points to reach Level 5.
However, instead of that, he was notified that he actually needed 3,000 Experience Points!
[ Progression Requirement Updated ]
[ Next Level: 3,000 Experience Points ]
Since a single drop gave 50 Experience Points, that meant he needed about 60 drops. Of course, there was no point in doing this drop by drop, so he decided to just take a small sip.
He only hoped that the excess Serum he consumed would carry over properly toward reaching Level 6.
"Eh? Sixty drops? That’s a lot... Just take a mouthful... Go!"
"Three thousand points, huh. We will guard you here. Don’t worry."
"I’m sure you’ll get a Gene Skill now."
"That will be perfect. Maybe your Talent will also improve, and the gift packs will give more items."
The four couldn’t help but imagine what kind of reward Kai would get. It was as if they weren’t in the A.I. Rebellion Apocalypse. They were all just happy to see theirleaderget stronger.
Kai nodded and lifted the vial. Then, he took a cautious sip.
Just like that, he let the golden liquid burn down his throat.
He immediately felt his body tense and heat even began spreading through his chest, but it didn’t take long, and the familiar rhythm settled. He quickly checked the system notifications.
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum Consumed ]
[ +2,660 Experience Points ]
[ Permanent Stat Increase: Health +200, Spirit +20 ]
Kai froze...
’I’m short by a few drops.’
Then, he turned to the Health Points and Spirit Points that he gained and realized that he had most likely reached the cap or the highest Health and Spirit Points he could get at this level.
Without wasting any more time, he prepared the dropper again. This time, he drew a few large drops and let them fall onto his tongue. Just like that, his body accepted all of it.
The system reacted instantly.
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 5 ]
[ Health Points +50 ]
[ Spirit Points +10 ]
[ Gene Skill Points +1 ]
[ Physique Rating Improved: E+ ]
[ Inventory Slots Expanded: +1 ]
"My physique finally improved..." Kai muttered as he saw the plus sign. It was something that Claire obtained at Level 2.
Then, he continued checking the notifications.
[ Title Upgrade: Survivor ]
[ Title Effect: Satiety decreases more slowly. Survivors can endure longer without food before hunger penalties occur. ]
"Oh? This is actually decent." Kai muttered as he saw the effect. He also realized that everyone would probably have a similar Title after reaching Level 5, so it would be very helpful.
Then, the long-awaited Gene Skill had finally arrived!
[ New Passive Gene Skill Activated! ]
[ Skill: Keen Sense (Level 0) ]
[ Description: Enhances sight and detection ability. Allows clearer vision in low light and improves awareness of hidden threats. ]
[ Note: Passive skills cannot be deactivated. Leveling requires Gene Skill Points. ]
"A Gene Skill. It’s here." Kai muttered as he felt that his senses had already improved.
It didn’t end there...
[ Congratulations! You are the First Survivor to reach Level 5! ]
[ Reward Granted: Tier 2 Survivor Gear ]
[ Description: A durable, system‐forged equipment set that adapts to your physique rating. ]
Seeing all of this felt so incredible... However, the last part stunned him for a moment.
[ Important Notice ]
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum Limit Reached. ]
[ Further consumption will not improve stats for the next 30 days. ]
[ Options: Wait until cooldown expires OR locate different versions of Gene Serum. ]
Kai’s eyes widened, and just as he was about to share the revelation with the others, the underground shelter shuddered violently.
The tremor was sudden... It was like the shockwave of a grenade detonating above ground. Dust had even drifted from the ceiling, and the old lamp on the wall swayed wildly...
"What’s happening outside?" Claire whispered.
Then, everyone instinctively turned toward the door as the sound of hurried footsteps echoed through the corridor.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: The First Battle
paragraphs: Kai was definitely happy to be the first Level 5 Survivor. It was a great achievement, and he really wanted to brag about it.
But he was also curious about the other types of Gene Enhancement Serums out there.

Considering he had to wait so long to level up using the Alpha version of the Serum, he believed there might actually be a Beta version that could grant better Experience Points or even greater Stat Increases.
Rumble!
However, the sudden earthquake disrupted his thoughts. He couldn’t even share the good news with everyone.
Suddenly, Russel burst into the chamber. He paused to catch his breath, his eyes darting across the room.
Kai and the others could tell immediately that this was not going to be good news.

"They’ve found us!" he shouted. "Two Sentinels and two Hounds... they destroyed the tunnel entrance with that advanced rifle. Our scout... he didn’t make it back. Either captured or forced to lead them here."
The room fell silent for a moment. This was a very important matter.
"Shit..." Victor cursed under his breath, while Claire’s face paled.
"We have to fight!" Russel declared with his trembling voice. He was hoping Kai and the others would agree. After all, he knew that fleeing would only make things more dangerous.
"Y-yes... We have no other choice," Claire muttered.

The thought of facing humanoid A.I. soldiers and beastframe wolves in such close quarters sent a chill through everyone. Their revolvers and bladed weapons felt pitiful against machines built for war. Yet the shelter’s narrow tunnels offered one advantage... the enemy’s numbers and mobility would be limited.
Kai had to think of a plan. He couldn’t let panic spread. "Where exactly did they breach?" he asked quickly.
Russel pointed toward the northern tunnel. "That passage. If they push through, they’ll reach the lower chambers in a few minutes."
Kai frowned, already familiar with that area. After a moment of consideration, he made up his mind.
"Then we collapse it."
Russel blinked, stunned at the suggestion. "Collapse the tunnel? That’s... risky."
But even as he said it, he realized it might be possible.
"Yes... It would stop them. The other Sentinels wouldn’t dare approach again if they thought this place was unstable." Russel nodded to himself.
"Is it possible to collapse that specific tunnel?" Claire asked.

"Yes!" Russel explained that they could do it by destroying the two pillars near the entrance. Thankfully, the Elder had already considered this scenario and prepared the shelter to collapse certain areas if necessary.
"That’s great." Kai smiled, knowing this would work. He had already noticed yesterday that the structure of the shelter was designed for that exact purpose.

"But before we collapse the tunnel, I want to test something. We’ll fire on them first. I need to know how effective our revolvers are against Sentinels and Hounds. If we’re going to survive long term, we can’t keep guessing."
Wallace frowned. "Kai... those things are armored. If the bullets bounce off—"
"Then we’ll know," Kai interrupted. "Better to learn now than wait until they storm the shelter. If the revolvers can pierce them, even a little, it changes everything."
The others exchanged uneasy glances. The idea of deliberately engaging the machines was terrifying, but Kai’s logic was undeniable.
Claire swallowed hard. "So... we fight, then collapse the tunnel?"
Kai’s gaze swept over them, and he nodded.

"Yes. We’ll strike first, measure their response, then retreat and bring the tunnel down. If we succeed, Haven‐45 will remain hidden. If we fail..." He clenched his fist. "...then at least we’ll know what we’re up against."
Russel tightened his grip on his blade and nodded. "Alright. I’ll guide you to the breach."
Soon, they informed the others of the plan so everyone could work together and execute it smoothly.
After their preparations, they noticed that the Sentinels and the Hounds were moving closer and closer to their location. They had to hurry.
At this point, those who couldn’t fight had already moved toward the farthest area to avoid harm.
As Kai’s group waited near the northern tunnel, the distant metallic echoes of the Sentinels and the Hounds reverberated through the stone.

"They’re coming..." Russel muttered as he slowly retreated, letting Kai and the others handle the enemies. At the same time, he signaled to Augustine and the other fighters to prepare for the destruction of the pillars.
Soon, Kai raised his hand, signaling the group to halt just before the bend.
"Positions. We’ll fire as soon as they appear. Ralph, aim for the joints and sensors. The rest, focus on their weapons."
Ralph, with his Sharpshooter’s Focus Talent, was skilled enough to hit his target. As for the others, they could rely on the narrow tunnel to at least land their shots.
Victor swallowed hard, gripping his revolver tightly. "If this doesn’t work..."
"Then we collapse the tunnel immediately," Kai cut in. "No hesitation."
The group pressed against the walls, revolvers ready.
Thud...

Suddenly, the first Sentinel appeared. It was humanoid but taller and with armored plating covering its body. A rifle was slung across its mechanical arms. Behind it, the Hounds crept forward while their metallic claws scraped against the stone floor.
"Fire!" Kai commanded.
The chamber erupted with gunfire. Bullets ricocheted off the tunnel walls, sparks flying as rounds struck the Sentinel’s armor.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
A couple of shots from Ralph hit the machine’s shoulder joint, causing it to stagger slightly. Another round from Kai and Wallace grazed the glowing sensor on its head, leaving a faint crack.
Not enough, huh...
Then, the Hounds charged forward while the Sentinels raised their rifles, glowing ominously.
"Collapse it now!" Kai shouted, having already obtained the information he needed.
As soon as Russel and the others pulled the weakened pillars to bring the tunnel down, a blast of energy erupted from the Sentinel’s rifle.

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Resources
paragraphs: Crack!
As the pillars cracked with a snap, the ceiling of the tunnel collapsed, blocking the attack of the Sentinel.
Boom!
The collapse triggered another explosion that made the northern tunnel cave in even faster. The impact then sent shockwaves through the shelter, shaking the walls and scattering dust everywhere.
Smoke and debris poured into the central chamber, choking the air and forcing everyone to cover their mouths.
Several lamps started failing, and the ground trembled as if the entire underground structure might give way.
’This is dangerous...’Kai thought as he hoped that this shelter could take this much disturbance.
For a moment, panic rippled through the survivors.
Workers scrambled to steady supplies, some others even started praying to their gods, and the fighters braced themselves for another assault.
But then... silence.
Everyone covered their mouths as they waited to see whether there would be some movement from the rubble.
Then, a few minutes passed, and the rubble settled... There was still dust everywhere, but it was already acceptable.
Kai finally lowered his revolver and relaxed for a bit...
The others, Claire, Wallace, Victor, and Ralph, exchanged glances. Their faces were pale but relieved that they had succeeded with the plan.
Of course, the residents of the shelter were the happiest about this matter. However, none of them dared to celebrate just yet...
Still, after a few more minutes, they could no longer hold their emotions. With no movement from beyond the collapsed tunnel, the tension broke. The workers cheered, clapping each other on the back.
Some even laughed nervously, celebrating the narrow escape.
But just as Kai was about to speak, a familiar glow filled his vision.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +400 Experience Points ]
"What? I got 400 Experience Points!" Claire exclaimed as she saw the message. It was the same for everyone who shot at the enemies.

"That’s a lot... We barely assisted in their destruction, but we still got so many experience points. They’re even Rank D Sentinels." Victor muttered as he carefully looked at the messages that continued to appear.
[ Congratulations! First Enemy Destruction Achieved. ]
[ Reward Granted: Survivor’s Medal x1 ]
[ Survivor’s Medal: It can be used to conduct transactions in the Gene Skill Store, with the elusive Secret Merchant, or among the Gene Traders. ]
"Medal... I got one. How about the others?" Ralph asked.
"I got one as well."
"I guess it’s the same for everyone’s first enemy destruction," Claire and Victor replied.
However, even after seeing these messages, Kai and Wallace focused on something else.
"How about the other three?" they both asked at the same time.
The others froze, realizing they had indeed received only a single confirmation of the enemy’s destruction.
"R‐right... Are they still alive?" Ralph said nervously, worried the machines might try to climb out of the rubble.
"Maybe they can’t move, and we can just wait until their battery or energy runs out," Kai guessed, since he believed that those androids or machines shouldn’t have unlimited energy.
Nonetheless, there was no need to speculate. Just a few moments later, another set of notifications appeared before their eyes...
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +400 Experience Points ]
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Hound (E) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +200 Experience Points ]
[ +200 Experience Points ]
"I leveled up! Yes! Level 4... and just a few more to reach Level 5!" Claire couldn’t help but celebrate at the sight of the Level Up notification.
It was the same for the other three. However, they soon realized that leveling up this way didn’t give them bonus Health and Spirit points, unlike through the method of consuming a serum!
Instead, they only got the bonus Health and Spirit Points provided by the process of levelling up.
If it were the Alphe Gene Enhancement Serum, the 200 Experience Points would’ve given them 20 more Health Points and 4 Spirit Points!
"What a letdown..." Victor muttered as he felt that leveling up using the Serum was simply better.
Still, the notifications didn’t end yet!
[ Sentinel’s Salvageable Loot: Cognitive Processor Unit, Targeting Optic Lens, Exo‐Frame Armor Shard, Energy Power Cell, Plasma Rifle ]
[ Hound’s Salvageable Loot: Beastframe Neural Core, Beast Claw Component, Synthetic Muscle Fiber, Hydraulic Joint Cylinder ]
[ Note: Only high‐value salvageable components are listed. Common debris and low‐grade materials are excluded. ]
The group stared at the new message, and their excitement faded into silence.
Ralph clicked his tongue. "Figures... all that salvage, and it’s buried under tons of stone."
Claire sighed. "Even if we tried to dig it out, the tunnel would collapse further. It’s impossible right now."
Victor rubbed the back of his neck and shook his head.
"And who knows if those components are even intact? The processor, the rifle... they might be shattered beyond use."
Wallace nodded as he knew that he wouldn’t want to dig up there. "Not worth the risk. We’d expose ourselves again just to chase scraps."
Kai, on the other hand, kept his gaze on the notification.
’Cognitive Processor Unit. Plasma Rifle. Beastframe Neural Core.’
The names alone gave them a lot of information. Next time, they might need to be careful not to heavily damage those components.
"It’s disappointing," Kai admitted. "But the system is at least telling us what’s possible. What we could gain if we find a way to salvage safely."
Hearing this, Claire finally managed a faint smile.
"Well, it’s at least proof that these machines aren’t just threats. They’re resources too."
The group agreed to her words as they all moved aside to let the Sanitation Crew and the others clean up the mess in the central chamber...
Soon, they started to relax for a bit.
But then, after everything had calmed down, Dustin finally revealed himself and approached them.
He stopped before Kai and the others and bowed his head slightly. "Leaders... the Elder requests your presence."

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Ambush or Not
paragraphs: "He wants to see us?" Claire frowned.
"Is it for revenge?" Victor asked.

Kai was curious too. Russel had already told them about the Elder, but they had never seen him. Since arriving at Haven‐45, the old man had remained hidden in the lowest chamber, sustained only by dextrose drips, medical devices, and the constant care of attendants.
"Hmm... We killed his three sons, Keagan, Julian, and Damon... so it’s not surprising that he wants to meet us," Ralph muttered.
Now that he was Level 4, he felt a lot more confident. He didn’t really mind going together to meet the mysterious Elder.

"Well, maybe he didn’t know his sons had hoarded the golden liquid, feeding only themselves and their chosen allies. Their arrogance left the shelter weak... They were even brave enough to order that guard to harm us. It’s messed up." Claire muttered.
Kai shook his head and turned directly to Dustin.
"Is he mad? Do you know why he’s calling for us?"
Dustin paused for a moment, recalling the Elder’s reaction.
"I think... he’s sad, but not angry. Maybe he just wants to see you and understand why things happened the way they did."
"Do you think it’s a trap?" Wallace asked softly.
Claire shot him a sharp look. "He’s already old. Russel said he couldn’t even move anymore. This shelter was built under his command... maybe we can learn something from him."
"Hmph... you’re too optimistic, Claire. Don’t underestimate that old man. He’s been alive for a long time. He must have consumed a lot of those Gene Enhancement Serums," Ralph said.
Kai agreed. Perhaps the Elder was the one who had consumed most of the Serum, and maybe he had even obtained a Gene Skill. They couldn’t afford to be complacent.
The Elder is weak, but not powerless. If he still has loyalists, this meeting could be dangerous. Or... it could be the chance to secure Haven‐45 completely.
Victor shifted uneasily after Ralph’s words. He hadn’t considered that angle before.
"Do we really have to go? He might just curse us for killing his sons. I don’t feel comfortable meeting him. It’s too suspicious."
Kai didn’t rush this matter. Instead, he asked Russel, who had been listening to them silently all this time.
"Tell me about the chamber. Where exactly is the Elder kept?"

Russel nodded and explained. "It’s the lowest chamber, past the storage hall and the medical wing. The room was previously a storage room and was quite narrow. Only one entrance, and he has three or four carers. He just lies in bed, surrounded by medical devices. There’s no other way in or out."
Kai nodded slowly. He was already mapping the situation in his mind.
Russel certainly knew what he wanted to know.
’One entrance. Narrow space. Easy to defend... but also easy to trap.’
"Russel, Augustine... Call your trusted friends. Have them guard the door for now until we go down. No one enters or leaves without our say. I’ll equip you all with hatchets at the very least."
Russel gave a nod, while Augustine immediately moved to gather the men.
Kai then outlined the plan to the others. "Claire and I will face the Elder directly. I just got a Gene Skill that enhances my senses, so it will keep me alert."
"Me? A-alright... I guess that makes sense." Claire muttered.
She also realized that with her Physical Strength Talent, she should be strong enough to carry Kai away if necessary.
"Ralph, you’ll stay at a distance... Wallace and Victor, you’ll stay with him. If anything happens, you three provide cover fire."
Ralph, with his Sharpshooter’s Focus Talent, knew that he just had to have a clear view of the target, so he liked this idea and nodded.
"Got it. If the old man tries anything, he won’t even get the chance."
Wallace and Victor also agreed with this plan.
Kai smiled. He was probably overthinking this matter, but since they were about to meet someone who had possibly consumed more Gene Enhancement Serums than them, he had to be cautious.
"With this setup, even if the Elder has bad intentions, we can fight back or retreat. The risk is still there, but it should give us some assurance."
The group agreed.
Still, Kai didn’t push them to move immediately. They had just survived the Sentinel attack, and exhaustion weighed on everyone.
"Rest first," Kai ordered. "We’ll go when we’re ready."
Soon, the kitchen crew was already preparing water, and after a few moments, steaming cups of tea were placed before them. The tea, a simple but comforting blend, was from the Food Gift Packs.
For a brief moment, the group sat together in silence, sipping slowly, letting the warmth settle in their bodies.
Only after this pause did Kai rise to his feet. "Alright. Let’s go."
With Russel and Augustine’s men stationed at the chamber entrance, hatchets in hand, and the five leaders in formation, they finally descended into the lowest part of Haven‐45.
The air grew colder as they moved deeper... Soon, the sound of the medical devices became faintly audible even before they reached the Elder’s room.
At last, they stood before the Elder’s door.
Russel and a few others already waited there.
"The Elder is inside. He’s waiting for you all."
Kai glanced at his companions, then stepped forward. "Let’s see what this old man has to say."
The door creaked open, and the warm air of the chamber swept out.
On the bed lay the Elder, who seemed frail and motionless. There were only tubes and wires keeping his body alive. For a moment, he seemed barely conscious.
However, his eyes snapped open, and they were glowing with a strange light.
Gene Skill!
The group froze as the Elder’s gaze locked onto them!
